bug_summary: Security依存関係のスコープ解決で `security_scopes or []` を新規リストとせず既存リストを直接extendして変更するため、兄弟依存関係間でスコープが意図せず伝播・リークする
pr_diff:
diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
index 45353835b..1e92c1ba2 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
@@ -278,9 +278,7 @@ def get_dependant(
             use_security_scopes = security_scopes or []
             if isinstance(param_details.depends, params.Security):
                 if param_details.depends.scopes:
-                    use_security_scopes = use_security_scopes + list(
-                        param_details.depends.scopes
-                    )
+                    use_security_scopes.extend(param_details.depends.scopes)
             sub_dependant = get_dependant(
                 path=path,
                 call=param_details.depends.dependency,
pr_title: Avoid extra list allocation when merging dependency security scopes
pr_description: Building `use_security_scopes` for a sub-dependency concatenated two lists with `+`, allocating a new list just to append the dependency's own scopes. This replaces it with `.extend(...)`, updating the list in place instead of constructing an intermediate one.
